title: BastionSummary
description: Summary information for a bastion resource. A bastion provides secured, public access to target resources in the cloud that you cannot otherwise reach from the internet. A bastion resides in a public subnet and establishes the network infrastructure needed to connect a user to a target resource in a private subnet.

compartmentId.description: The unique identifier (OCID) of the compartment where the bastion is located.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only string, integer and boolean types are supported.

Key-value pair representing predefined tags' keys and values scoped to a namespace.
Example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

definedTags.description:
Defined tags for this resource. Each key is predefined and scoped to a namespace.
Example: `{"foo-namespace": {"bar-key": "value"}}`

dnsProxyStatus.description: The current dns proxy status of the bastion.

freeformTags.description:
Simple key-value pair that is applied without any predefined name, type or scope. Exists for cross-compatibility only.
Example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

id.description: The unique identifier (OCID) of the bastion, which can't be changed after creation.

lifecycleDetails.description: A message describing the current state in more detail.

lifecycleState.description: The current state of the bastion.

name.description: The name of the bastion, which can't be changed after creation.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only string, integer and boolean types are supported.

Key-value pair representing system tags' keys and values scoped to a namespace.
Example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

systemTags.description:
Usage of system tag keys. These predefined keys are scoped to namespaces.
Example: `{"orcl-cloud": {"free-tier-retained": "true"}}`

targetSubnetId.description: The unique identifier (OCID) of the subnet that the bastion connects to.

targetVcnId.description: The unique identifier (OCID) of the virtual cloud network (VCN) that the bastion connects to.

timeCreated.description:
The time the bastion was created. Format is defined by [RFC3339](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339).
Example: `2020-01-25T21:10:29.600Z`

timeUpdated.description:
The time the bastion was updated. Format is defined by [RFC3339](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339).
Example: `2020-01-25T21:10:29.600Z`
